verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Grafana SLO lets SREs define SLIs and SLOs and 'how to react' when service falls short, and Grafana Alerting provides general alert rules with notifications. The docs shown never explicitly mention error budgets or burn-rate alerting, so those parts are only implied. The SLO feature is also documented only under Grafana Cloud. Missing for 10: explicit error-budget tracking, documented multi-window burn-rate alerts, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SLO workflow.
